def: Examples kept out of training so that performance on them estimates how the model handles new inputs.
The test set is scored rarely and never used to make choices, while the development set is used repeatedly to select checkpoints and settings.
Training on data before a date and testing on data after it, to mimic facing the future.
The presence of evaluation items, or close variants, in a model's training data, which inflates scores.
A contamination test that flags evaluation items sharing runs of n consecutive words or tokens with the training data.
A program that builds prompts, runs a model on a set of tasks, scores the outputs and records the settings, so different models are compared by identical code.
Resampling evaluation items with both models' outcomes kept together to get an interval for the difference in their scores.
The probability that at least one of k sampled attempts at a task is correct, estimated without bias from n at least k samples.
The loss of earlier abilities when a model is fine-tuned on a new task.
A fixed set of evaluations of capabilities to keep, run on every new version of a model to catch unintended losses.
